IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Hinkle, Pearson, Hope, O'Brien, Klippert, McCune, Morrell, and Kristiansen

Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing penalties for driving under the influence of liquor or drugs while transporting a person under age eighteen.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to driving under the influence of liquor or drugswhile transporting a person under age eighteen; adding a new section tochapter 46.61 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person who is convicted of a violation of RCW 46.61.502 or46.61.504 is guilty of a class C felony punishable under chapter 9A.20RCW, if the person committed the violation while transporting a personunder eighteen years of age.
